description: Primary local load-test cockpit: outcome, offered load, queue flow, application bottlenecks, and dependency health.

panels.description: Completed API requests per second for selected routes.
panels.title: API throughput

panels.description: Server-side 5xx percentage for selected routes.
panels.title: API 5xx errors

panels.description: Messages currently ready for delivery in selected queues.
panels.title: Ready backlog

panels.description: Age of the oldest deliverable message; rising age means consumers are falling behind.
panels.title: Oldest ready message

panels.description: Run totals for dropped load, container OOMs, and PostgreSQL deadlocks. Any non-zero value needs investigation.
panels.title: Hard failures

panels.description: Server processing latency and k6 end-to-end request latency. k6 series are absent outside a load run.
panels.title: Client and server latency

panels.description: Active and maximum k6 virtual users. No data is expected outside a load run.
panels.title: Virtual users

panels.description: k6 scenario iterations and completed API requests per second.
panels.title: Achieved work rate

panels.description: Unexpected HTTP response and failed-check ratios from k6.
panels.title: Request and check failures

panels.description: Ingress and successful acknowledgement rates; a persistent gap predicts backlog growth.
panels.title: Enqueue vs acknowledge

panels.description: Queue depth by priority and delivery state.
panels.title: Ready vs in-flight depth

panels.description: Oldest ready and in-flight message by priority.
panels.title: Oldest message age

panels.description: Expired and dead-lettered messages per second. Production-day tests intentionally create a small bounded cohort.
panels.title: Exceptional outcomes

panels.description: Age of the queue-state snapshot used by all queue gauges.
panels.title: Snapshot age

panels.description: p95 and p99 duration per selected database operation; operations are never blended.
panels.title: Database operation latency

panels.description: Time spent waiting for a SQLx pool connection.
panels.title: Pool acquisition latency

panels.description: Used SQLx connections as a percentage of the configured pool maximum.
panels.title: Pool utilization

panels.description: CPU cores consumed by selected local containers.
panels.title: CPU usage

panels.description: Percentage of CFS periods throttled for selected containers.
panels.title: CPU throttling

panels.description: Working-set memory as a percentage of the configured container limit.
panels.title: Memory utilization

panels.description: Scrape health for Retsu, PgBouncer, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, and container metrics.
panels.title: Target health

panels.description: Active sessions and total current backends for the Retsu database. A server configured maximum is not exported by the current metric set.
panels.title: PostgreSQL sessions

panels.description: Used and idle SQLx connections alongside the configured application pool maximum. This is not the PostgreSQL server max_connections setting.
panels.title: Application pool connections

panels.description: Current PostgreSQL locks by mode; investigate unusual sustained growth with the diagnostics dashboard.
panels.title: Locks by mode

panels.description: Active and waiting client connections for the Retsu route. Any waiting client indicates pool pressure; N/A means the exporter is absent.
panels.title: PgBouncer clients

panels.description: Active and idle PgBouncer server connections for the Retsu route; N/A means the exporter is absent.
panels.title: PgBouncer backends

panels.description: Maximum wait age of queued clients for the Retsu route. Any sustained non-zero value indicates saturation; N/A means the exporter is absent.
panels.title: PgBouncer max client wait
